Name: Montag's Modern Wallpapers and Hardwoods
Author: Piliferous
Description:
[size=3][b]Thank you for downloading Montag's Modern Wallpapers and Hardwoods! [color=#c27ba0] UPDATED WITH NEW FLOORING, AND FULLY COMPATIBLE WITH 1.5!

[/color][/b][/size][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]CWF VERSION AVAILABLE (but not recommended, CWF is fairly broken)[/size][/color][/b]

I was tired of the lack of quality hardwood floor options within the base game, so I decided to create a clean and modern pack of wallpapers and flooring to help bring a touch of sophistication and simplicity in design to the interior of the farmhouse.  See the above pictures for a "staged farmhouse" photograph as well as each of the individual patterns used.

This mod is a Content Patcher pack, so please be sure you have Content Patcher downloaded.  

[left]__________________________________________________________________

[b][u]To Install Main Version:
[/u][/b]1. Ensure Content Patcher and SMAPI are up to date
2. Download and unzip the mod file
3. Place the entire folder within the ﻿ ﻿“\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

﻿__________________________________________________________________

﻿[b][u]To Install CWF Version:[/u][/b][/left]1. Ensure Content Patcher, CWF, PyTK Toolkit, and SMAPI are up to date
2. Download and unzip the mod file
3. Place the entire folder within the ﻿ ﻿“\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010]CWF[/url]﻿
[/b][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url][/b][/size]

﻿__________________________________________________________________

If anyone is curious, the furniture mod in the staged photograph is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1731]Mi's and Magimatica Country Furniture[/url]﻿.  Feel free to send any suggestions or issues to me via message!
